content:
Few places in the world can match the allure of Delhi. Whether you are planning a trip to Delhi for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to explore Delhi depends on what you want to experience. Winter transforms the landscape into a magical wonderland.

## Top Attractions

- Famous attractions that define Delhi
- Hidden treasures only locals know about
- Natural sites that tell the story of India
- Scenic lookouts for unforgettable photos

![Delhi landscape](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1592639296346-560c37a0f711?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Local Cuisine

No trip to Delhi is complete without sampling the local food. From street-side vendors to fine dining establishments, the culinary scene reflects the region's rich heritage and innovative spirit.

## Getting Around

Public transport in Delhi is efficient and affordable, making it easy to explore without a car.

## Where to Stay

Homestays are a great way to immerse yourself in local culture while visiting Delhi.
